Something ive been wanting to do for quite literally years now <3 Because of this, I am actually going to be looking for an artist to do all the nsfw ish transformations! Currently I have reserved about 100 USD for this. Though I am looking for like, probably 100ish images or something insane like that. So I dont expect people to really apply for this lol. Im fine with normal art, however im also down with kisekae2, honey select, com3d2, etc. If your not sure, you can always send me some examples (im going to want examples anyway of your work). Im still working on the rough draft so im in no rush to find people rn. This is more of a shot in the dark.
